items.title: Lawrence Cotton Interview, 1996-12-10
items.q: I think you played in Atlanta for Mr. Beeman

ctx.x: Took Jesse Allen to go as Ray Charles. Earl King to go as Guitar Slim. Now, we had played in Flint, Michigan. We had played up there with the regular band with Slim before this happened. They had some people up there. We talked with them and everything went down fine. Now, we went to Bessma, Alabama with Earl as Slim and Jesse as Ray Charles. Now, Jesse put his glasses on but he's going to go stand by the mic and sing. I'm sitting at the piano playing. So we had uniforms on. We came out with a, we had a rust…
Yeah, I think you played in Atlanta for Mr. Beeman. Yes. Mr. Beeman. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah.

I have been to Atlanta. I don't know. I don't even know what it looked like. They've revamped everything and everything is, it's all together different around there. Just like the Dewdrop is not the same anymore. In fact, even the 5-4 Bar Room in Los Angeles is not the same. The one in Detroit, they had a Wala Haja Hotel we played in Atlanta. That's not there anymore. We played a hotel in Detroit. That's not there anymore. So all the places that we plant, they're no longer in existence, you know?
